blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. on Tuesday honored 10 outstanding Filipinos for their exceptional dedication to education and national security during the 2026 Metrobank Foundation Outstanding Filipinos. He presided over the awarding of the Medallion of Excellence to the 10 honorees during a ceremony at Malacañan Palace, where four teachers, three soldiers, and three police officers were recognized for exemplifying patriotism, integrity, courage, and social responsibility.
